{
  "summary": "Four necessary coverage obligations remain: the new array and object depth rejections are unreachable, and Raw child printing was already unreachable in both container types. The new guards do not reject trees accepted by the parser.",
  "coverage_complete": true,
  "coverage_evidence": [
    {"unit_id":"u-dfded03049d6b0ff4a77","start_line":1,"end_line":3191,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""},

    {"unit_id":"u-c324296ad5700dc5cf3e","start_line":6,"end_line":13,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Shows the before build configuration and link path."},
    {"unit_id":"u-a9bf5d46a284ae6666a8","start_line":6,"end_line":13,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Shows the after build configuration and link path."}
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim_id":"o-b21b8a1a023bb95c",
      "necessary":"yes",
      "necessity_reason":"A finite array tree made with the public constructor and append API can place an array at the default depth limit. The new printer returns failure there, while the harness prints only trees that the parser accepted; parsing rejects that depth first.",
      "before":{
        "requirement":"Reach the array printer’s depth-limit rejection for a constructed array tree.",
        "applicability":"not_applicable",
        "harness_status":"not_applicable",
        "reason":"The complete old array printer has no depth-limit rejection.",
        "source_evidence":[{"unit_id":"u-8a2e48144aa491bf2afa","start_line":1590,"end_line":1649,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""}]
      },
      "after":{
        "requirement":"Reach the array printer’s externally visible failure for a constructed array at CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.",
        "applicability":"required",
        "harness_status":"unsat",
        "reason":"The new guard fails at depth 1000 under the supplied build and header default. The harness has no construction route, and both container parsers reject a node at that depth before printing.",
        "source_evidence":[
          {"unit_id":"u-10164794035fd98e9f53","start_line":1590,"end_line":1623,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""},
          {"unit_id":"u-409f14716b684d5aa3fb","start_line":137,"end_line":138,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Provides the default depth limit."},
          {"unit_id":"u-18e9cc660ae8d3d41bec","start_line":2022,"end_line":2059,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Public append operations can connect constructed array nodes."},
          {"unit_id":"u-18e9cc660ae8d3d41bec","start_line":2593,"end_line":2602,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"The public constructor creates array nodes."},
          {"unit_id":"u-c9dc7a6c08ea3df8f2fb","start_line":1497,"end_line":1501,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Array parsing rejects a node at the same limit."},
          {"unit_id":"u-ffb083b8e8ccec9ca0e7","start_line":1662,"end_line":1666,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Object parsing also blocks mixed nesting at that limit."},
          {"unit_id":"u-754c6b145694677e3141","start_line":1252,"end_line":1255,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"An array print failure propagates to the public unbuffered printer."}
        ]
      },
      "same_blocker":"not_applicable",
      "harness_evidence":[
        {"unit_id":"u-2c6fc2ab237f6911c41e","start_line":22,"end_line":55,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""},
        {"unit_id":"u-a9bf5d46a284ae6666a8","start_line":6,"end_line":13,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"The supplied build recipe invokes CMake without overriding CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT."},
        {"unit_id":"u-746ef56bdf8ebb2d1fa3","start_line":111,"end_line":130,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"The CMake library target compiles cJSON.c under the supplied defaults."}
      ],
      "comparison_reason":"g0001 adds an observable print failure for constructed deep arrays. The fixed harness cannot provide such an array to any printer.",
      "missing_information":[],
      "change_ids":["g0001"]
    },
    {
      "claim_id":"o-ea11e672ca43f769",
      "necessary":"yes",
      "necessity_reason":"Public object construction and insertion can form a finite tree at the default depth limit. The added object guard rejects it, but the harness only prints parser-produced trees, which cannot reach that depth.",
      "before":{
        "requirement":"Reach the object printer’s depth-limit rejection for a constructed object tree.",
        "applicability":"not_applicable",
        "harness_status":"not_applicable",
        "reason":"The complete old object printer has no depth-limit rejection.",

      },
      "after":{

        "applicability":"required",
        "harness_status":"unsat",
        "reason":"The new guard fails at the default limit. Parsing rejects array and object nodes at that same depth, and the harness never constructs a deeper object tree.",
        "source_evidence":[
          {"unit_id":"u-c79e1dc70f6960d4f130","start_line":1775,"end_line":1800,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""},
          {"unit_id":"u-409f14716b684d5aa3fb","start_line":137,"end_line":138,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Provides the default depth limit."},

          {"unit_id":"u-ffb083b8e8ccec9ca0e7","start_line":1662,"end_line":1666,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Object parsing rejects a node at the printer’s threshold."},
          {"unit_id":"u-c9dc7a6c08ea3df8f2fb","start_line":1497,"end_line":1501,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Array parsing prevents mixed nesting from bypassing the threshold."},
          {"unit_id":"u-754c6b145694677e3141","start_line":1252,"end_line":1255,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"An object print failure propagates to the public unbuffered printer."}
        ]
      },
      "same_blocker":"not_applicable",
      "harness_evidence":[
        {"unit_id":"u-2c6fc2ab237f6911c41e","start_line":22,"end_line":55,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""},
        {"unit_id":"u-a9bf5d46a284ae6666a8","start_line":6,"end_line":13,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"The supplied recipe does not override CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT."},
        {"unit_id":"u-746ef56bdf8ebb2d1fa3","start_line":111,"end_line":130,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"The CMake target compiles cJSON.c under the supplied defaults."}
      ],
      "comparison_reason":"g0002 adds an observable print failure for constructed deep objects. The same old harness cannot supply one.",
      "missing_information":[],
      "change_ids":["g0002"]
    },
    {
      "claim_id":"o-0050695b3e3ec3e5",
      "necessary":"yes",
      "necessity_reason":"A shallow array with a constructed cJSON_Raw child is a supported print input. Raw output preserves the child’s stored text, but parsing cannot create Raw and the harness never inserts one.",
      "before":{
        "requirement":"Reach printing of an array containing a cJSON_Raw child.",
        "applicability":"required",
        "harness_status":"unsat",
        "reason":"The array printer delegates children to a value printer with a Raw case. Parsed array children come from parse_value, whose complete dispatch has no Raw case.",
        "source_evidence":[
          {"unit_id":"u-8a2e48144aa491bf2afa","start_line":1613,"end_line":1618,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""},
          {"unit_id":"u-a04727a1550fe06c4370","start_line":1459,"end_line":1474,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Defines distinct Raw child rendering."},
          {"unit_id":"u-a372fdabe22034ac7547","start_line":2566,"end_line":2581,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Creates a supported Raw child."},
          {"unit_id":"u-e76c009ca2d9a53cc462","start_line":2046,"end_line":2049,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Exposes array insertion."},
          {"unit_id":"u-4f98c77a836ed361d577","start_line":1550,"end_line":1555,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Parsed array children use parse_value."},
          {"unit_id":"u-034a84c5c6a2bf7130d1","start_line":1363,"end_line":1415,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Complete parser dispatch cannot produce Raw."}
        ]
      },
      "after":{
        "requirement":"Reach printing of an array containing a cJSON_Raw child.",
        "applicability":"required",
        "harness_status":"unsat",
        "reason":"The new guard permits a shallow constructed array, but the fixed harness still passes only parsed trees to its printers.",
        "source_evidence":[
          {"unit_id":"u-10164794035fd98e9f53","start_line":1601,"end_line":1623,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""},
          {"unit_id":"u-22c12501aa8490ba4dad","start_line":1459,"end_line":1474,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Raw child rendering remains supported."},
          {"unit_id":"u-23d6d2a906eb9c2a1c4f","start_line":2576,"end_line":2591,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"The Raw constructor remains available."},
          {"unit_id":"u-50d95a5fc2b98f95819c","start_line":2056,"end_line":2059,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Array insertion remains available."},
          {"unit_id":"u-c9dc7a6c08ea3df8f2fb","start_line":1550,"end_line":1555,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Parsed array children still use parse_value."},
          {"unit_id":"u-1ee25c3beec8386b43e1","start_line":1363,"end_line":1415,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Complete parser dispatch still cannot produce Raw."}
        ]
      },
      "same_blocker":"yes",
      "harness_evidence":[{"unit_id":"u-2c6fc2ab237f6911c41e","start_line":13,"end_line":72,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""}],
      "comparison_reason":"On both sides, the same parse-only tree setup prevents a Raw array child from reaching printing. A finite supported setup is an array containing cJSON_CreateRaw(\"1 \"); parsing `[1 ]` instead creates a Number child.",
      "missing_information":[],
      "change_ids":["g0001"]
    },
    {
      "claim_id":"o-5fe1a4eaca45b4db",
      "necessary":"yes",
      "necessity_reason":"The source supports a shallow object with a Raw member whose stored text is printed verbatim. The harness prints parsed objects only; parsing creates no Raw member.",
      "before":{
        "requirement":"Reach printing of an object containing a cJSON_Raw member.",
        "applicability":"required",
        "harness_status":"unsat",
        "reason":"The object printer delegates each member to the Raw-capable value printer, while object parsing delegates member values to parse_value, which cannot create Raw.",
        "source_evidence":[
          {"unit_id":"u-676dee013b57517607db","start_line":1834,"end_line":1839,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""},
          {"unit_id":"u-a04727a1550fe06c4370","start_line":1459,"end_line":1474,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Defines verbatim Raw rendering."},
          {"unit_id":"u-dfded03049d6b0ff4a77","start_line":2207,"end_line":2217,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Provides a supported Raw member construction route."},
          {"unit_id":"u-636fe28db4f6480ce4f9","start_line":1731,"end_line":1737,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Parsed object members use parse_value."},
          {"unit_id":"u-034a84c5c6a2bf7130d1","start_line":1363,"end_line":1415,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Complete parser dispatch cannot produce Raw."}
        ]
      },
      "after":{
        "requirement":"Reach printing of an object containing a cJSON_Raw member.",
        "applicability":"required",
        "harness_status":"unsat",
        "reason":"The shallow Raw member remains supported after the depth guard, but the fixed harness has no construction or insertion step.",
        "source_evidence":[
          {"unit_id":"u-c79e1dc70f6960d4f130","start_line":1786,"end_line":1789,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""},
          {"unit_id":"u-c79e1dc70f6960d4f130","start_line":1844,"end_line":1849,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""},
          {"unit_id":"u-22c12501aa8490ba4dad","start_line":1459,"end_line":1474,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Verbatim Raw rendering remains supported."},
          {"unit_id":"u-18e9cc660ae8d3d41bec","start_line":2217,"end_line":2227,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"The Raw member construction route remains available."},
          {"unit_id":"u-ffb083b8e8ccec9ca0e7","start_line":1736,"end_line":1742,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Parsed object members still use parse_value."},
          {"unit_id":"u-1ee25c3beec8386b43e1","start_line":1363,"end_line":1415,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Complete parser dispatch still cannot produce Raw."}
        ]
      },
      "same_blocker":"yes",
      "harness_evidence":[{"unit_id":"u-2c6fc2ab237f6911c41e","start_line":13,"end_line":72,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""}],
      "comparison_reason":"Both versions support printing a constructed Raw object member. The same harness constraint blocks it: parsing `{\"x\":1e0}` creates a Number, while adding a Raw member holding `1e0` would preserve that spelling.",
      "missing_information":[],
      "change_ids":["g0002"]
    },
    {
      "claim_id":"o-fe1abcbfcbc56d57",
      "necessary":"no",
      "necessity_reason":"No parser-accepted array reaches the new print guard: parsing and printing start at depth zero and use the same pre-increment limit for arrays and objects.",
      "before":{
        "requirement":"Print a parser-produced array at every nesting depth accepted by parsing.",
        "applicability":"required",
        "harness_status":"sat",
        "reason":"The old array printer has no depth rejection.",
        "source_evidence":[{"unit_id":"u-8a2e48144aa491bf2afa","start_line":1590,"end_line":1649,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""}]
      },
      "after":{
        "requirement":"Print a parser-produced array at every nesting depth accepted by parsing.",
        "applicability":"required",
        "harness_status":"sat",
        "reason":"The new guard rejects an array only at a depth the parser already rejects.",
        "source_evidence":[

          {"unit_id":"u-c9dc7a6c08ea3df8f2fb","start_line":1497,"end_line":1501,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Array parsing applies the same depth limit."},

          {"unit_id":"u-22435c21ee969976166f","start_line":1142,"end_line":1167,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Parsing initializes depth to zero."},
          {"unit_id":"u-754c6b145694677e3141","start_line":1234,"end_line":1253,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Unbuffered printing initializes depth to zero."},
          {"unit_id":"u-ffba1348e0b827e3c66a","start_line":1312,"end_line":1333,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Buffered printing initializes depth to zero."}
        ]
      },
      "same_blocker":"not_applicable",
      "harness_evidence":[{"unit_id":"u-2c6fc2ab237f6911c41e","start_line":34,"end_line":53,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""}],
      "comparison_reason":"The fixed harness prints parser-produced arrays on both sides; its accepted-depth behavior remains reachable.",
      "missing_information":[],
      "change_ids":["g0001"]
    },
    {
      "claim_id":"o-3b92df31c07ba4a0",
      "necessary":"no",
      "necessity_reason":"No parser-accepted object reaches the new print guard because both parsers reject container nodes at the same depth threshold.",

        "applicability":"required",

        "source_evidence":[{"unit_id":"u-676dee013b57517607db","start_line":1770,"end_line":1881,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""}]
      },
      "after":{
        "requirement":"Print a parser-produced object at every nesting depth accepted by parsing.",
        "applicability":"required",
        "harness_status":"sat",
        "reason":"The new object guard rejects only a container depth that parsing already rejects.",
        "source_evidence":[
          {"unit_id":"u-c79e1dc70f6960d4f130","start_line":1781,"end_line":1800,"role":"primary","dependency_reason":""},
          {"unit_id":"u-ffb083b8e8ccec9ca0e7","start_line":1662,"end_line":1666,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Object parsing applies the same depth limit."},
          {"unit_id":"u-c9dc7a6c08ea3df8f2fb","start_line":1497,"end_line":1501,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Array parsing applies it to mixed nesting."},
          {"unit_id":"u-10164794035fd98e9f53","start_line":1601,"end_line":1616,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Array printing counts mixed container depth consistently."},
          {"unit_id":"u-22435c21ee969976166f","start_line":1142,"end_line":1167,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Parsing initializes depth to zero."},
          {"unit_id":"u-754c6b145694677e3141","start_line":1234,"end_line":1253,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Unbuffered printing initializes depth to zero."},
          {"unit_id":"u-ffba1348e0b827e3c66a","start_line":1312,"end_line":1333,"role":"dependency","dependency_reason":"Buffered printing initializes depth to zero."}
        ]
      },
